channel.title: Foxy's Lab
channel.description: Smart home and homelab tech without the corporate waffle. Honest reviews, local control advocacy, and the occasional strongly-worded opinion about cloud-dependent tat.

item.title: Every Core Node-RED Node, Explained
item.description: The companion guide to my three-part Node-RED series. Every built-in node - Common, Function, Network, Parser, Sequence and Storage - what it does, when to reach for it, with working demo flows you can import and run yourself.

item.title: Getting Started with Home Assistant on a Mini PC
item.description: A complete walkthrough for installing Home Assistant on a mini PC or x86 hardware, setting up Zigbee devices, integrations, and HACS. Companion article to the full video guide.

item.title: Well, This Looks Different
item.description: Foxy's Lab has a blog now. Here's why, what to expect, and a brief history of how we got here.
